name: Confirm shelter decision
description: Confirm that sheltering is safer than evacuation based on conditions and plan triggers.
notes: Update if conditions shift toward evacuation.

name: Account for household
description: Confirm all people and pets are present, safe, or accounted for elsewhere.
completion_evidence: Every person and pet accounted for

name: Move to shelter area
description: Move essential supplies, lights, communications gear, pets, and medical items to the shelter area.

name: Inventory water
description: Check available water and estimate remaining duration.
notes: Share need only if supply is inadequate.

name: Inventory food
description: Check food, dietary needs, cooking options, and no-cook backup.
notes: Plan meals to conserve fuel and water.

name: Set sanitation
description: Prepare toilet, waste, hygiene, cleaning, diaper, and handwashing arrangements.

name: Safety and security check
description: Check locks, alarms, smoke/CO detectors, windows, heat/cold exposure, and safe movement.
notes: Use softer “safety” wording for general users.

name: Communications schedule
description: Set check-in times to preserve battery and avoid missed status updates.

name: Medical and dependent check
description: Check medications, symptoms, comfort, mobility, medical devices, and dependent needs.

name: Power conservation
description: Limit device use, rotate chargers, and reserve power for communications and medical needs.

name: Periodic status update
description: Send a short update at the agreed cadence with water, power, medical, mobility, and communications status.

name: End shelter and recover
description: When safe, send all-clear, check damage, restore supplies, recharge devices, and update readiness score.
completion_evidence: All-clear sent and recovery tasks started
notes: Capture lessons learned for next drill.
